chapter: Piron, Pichon and the boat bands
title: Line-up of Pichon's band on the Pelican
summary: Williams names Pichon's players on the Pelican, including Raymond Brown, Sidney Correa, Colbert, Augustine and old man Kimball.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: I don't know whether he was or not. I don't know who was the manager of that band. I can't tell. Where did Pichon play, by the way? Pichon? Yeah, yeah. Pichon, the first job Pichon played with was Sam Morgan. No.

No, I mean, when you, uh. When I was playing with him? When you were playing with him. On the Pelican. I see. And, uh, who was the tenor player then? I never did get that straight. With Pichon. Who was on the Pelican? Me, Pichon.

Me, Pichon, Raymond Brown, Bat Brown, was playing trumpet, Sidney Correa, was playing tenor. Colbet was playing alto. That's right. Which Colbet? Colbet. The one who was in Los Angeles. He got a brother here, but the one who went to Los Angeles, he died, I heard. Did you hear that? I don't know. I haven't heard of him. Colbet was alto and Sidney Correa on tenor. Oh, I see. And, uh, Augustine, George Augustine on guitar, old man Kimball on bass. Kendall's daddy, you know.
Which one is Reese Colbet? What do you know? That's true. Yeah, I don't know what's supposed to be.
No, he's a saxophone player, too. Yeah, but this one went to Los Angeles to go to a while. Wrong time ago. That was the band.
